intro: Trying to find Indiana scholarships tied to financial need without sorting through higher-dollar awards first? This filtered USA view narrows the search to programs with listed amounts under ten thousand dollars, so you can compare a focused set of listings more quickly. The rows below span areas such as education, community, STEM, law, disability, and other miscellaneous topics, with study levels that can include high school seniors, college students, and graduate students. Awards vary by listing, and so do deadlines, residency or citizenship details, essay expectations, and other requirement lines. Some options may be lighter-touch than others, but every program should be verified on its official page before you apply.

faq.question: Can I apply to every scholarship listed here if I live in Indiana?
faq.answer: Not automatically. This catalog slice is Indiana-focused, but each program may also set its own rules for study level, residency or citizenship in the USA, field of study, or other requirements listed on the official source.

faq.question: What should I compare before I apply?
faq.answer: Check the award amount, deadline, study level, category, and any essay or document requirements for each listing. Deadlines differ by program, and some rows may be lighter-touch than others, so it helps to compare a few options side by side before applying.

faq.question: Are these only for one major or type of student?
